items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify set before any other cold-and-dark action.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Speed brake lever must be stowed before power-up.
items.label: Speed Brake Lever

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify flap lever is in the UP detent.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Center Pedestal. All four engine master switches off before powering up.
items.label: Engine Masters

items.info: Center Pedestal. All four thrust levers at idle.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Engine mode selector in the NORM position.
items.label: ENG Mode Selector

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both wipers off.
items.label: Wipers

items.info: Overhead Panel. All four switches: BAT1, BAT2, ESS BAT, APU BAT.
items.label: Battery

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connect in order 2-3-4-1 if a GPU is available. Skip if you only have the APU.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red left wingtip, green right wingtip, white tail. On from power-up to shutdown.
items.label: NAV Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU Master ON, wait 3 seconds, then APU Start ON. Wait for AVAIL in the start button before using APU bleed or generators.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Opens the oxygen valve for the crew masks. Set and forget.
items.label: Oxygen Crew Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. All three IRs to NAV. The inertial reference system needs several minutes to align — start it early.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. In AUTO the strobes turn on automatically when airborne and off on the ground.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seat Belts ON, No Mobile ON.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Floor-path lighting that fires automatically if cabin power drops. Close the guard once armed.
items.label: Emergency Exit Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Sends APU pressurised air into the pneumatic duct for air conditioning and later engine start.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnect in order 1-4-3-2 once APU is supplying power. Only relevant if you connected ground power earlier.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. All pumps from left to right for tanks that have fuel. The A380 has up to 11 fuel tanks across the wings and fuselage.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Center Pedestal. VHF1 active for ATC communication.
items.label: Radio Panel

items.info: Center Pedestal. Recorded broadcast of weather, runway in use, and field conditions at the departure airport.
items.label: ATIS

items.info: Center Pedestal. IFR clearance from delivery — SID, initial altitude, squawk code.
items.label: ATC Clearance

items.info: Center Pedestal. INIT page: enter or import route (FROM/TO, FLT NBR, COST INDEX, CRZ FL). F-PLN: verify waypoints, select departure RWY/SID/TRANS. PERF: after boarding, enter ZFW/ZFWCG/BLOCK from the fuel page, then set V1/VR/V2, FLEX or TOGA, flap config, THS trim, and acceleration altitudes.
items.label: MCDU Preflight

items.info: Glareshield. Both captain and FO barometric references set to local QNH. Should read field elevation on the ground.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Glareshield. The green bars on the PFD that command pitch and roll guidance.
items.label: Flight Director

items.info: Glareshield. Set initial cleared altitude or cruise altitude.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Center Pedestal. FMS SURV page — enter squawk code from clearance, set to AUTO (stays on ground until airborne).
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Overhead Panel. Confirm all three ADIRS have completed alignment — no amber ALIGN lights remaining.
items.label: IRS Alignment

items.info: Main Panel. Both sliding windows closed for pressurization.
items.label: Windows

items.info: Overhead Panel. Confirm APU is running and available for engine start bleed.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. The flashing red anti-collision light on top and bottom of the fuselage. Required before any engine start so ground crew know the engines are about to spool.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both Seat Belts and No Mobile signs on before pushback.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Center Pedestal. Ground controller confirms pushback approved and area clear.
items.label: Pushback Clearance

items.info: Center Pedestal. Moves the ignition mode from NORM to IGN/START, which enables the start sequence when you flip the engine masters.
items.label: ENG Mode Selector

items.info: Center Pedestal. Left-side engines first. Flip both master switches ON — the FADEC handles the start sequence automatically. Monitor N2 and EGT on the ECAM.
items.label: Engine 1+2 Masters

items.info: Center Pedestal. Right-side engines after the left pair stabilises at idle. Same automatic start sequence.
items.label: Engine 3+4 Masters

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set after pushback is complete and tug disconnected.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Return to NORM after all four engines are stable at idle.
items.label: ENG Mode Selector

items.info: Overhead Panel. The engines now supply bleed air — APU bleed no longer needed.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shut down the APU.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Center Pedestal. Per the MCDU PERF page — typically Config 2 on the A380.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms the spoilers so they deploy automatically on a rejected takeoff or after touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify centered. An offset here causes the aircraft to yaw on the takeoff roll.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Center Pedestal. Match the PFD trim index to the magenta CG% value shown in the lower right corner of the PFD.
items.label: Pitch Trim

items.info: Center Pedestal. Full sidestick deflection in all axes — confirm correct surface movement on ECAM flight controls page.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Overhead Panel. Forward-facing light on the nose gear for ground visibility.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Wing-root lights that illuminate taxiway turnoffs. Useful at night.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Center Pedestal. Release to begin taxi.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedals. Check braking and nosewheel steering at low speed. Max 20 kts straight, 5 kts in turns — the A380 is 575 tonnes and the gear is wide.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Leave ON unless performance-limited.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turn on if visible moisture and OAT below 10°C.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Center Pedestal. FMS SURV page. Full resolution advisory mode — the system can now command CLIMB or DESCEND to avoid traffic.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms maximum braking if you abort the takeoff and bring thrust levers back to idle.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. Confirm the speed brake lever shows green ARMED annunciation.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Cross-check the ECAM flap indicator matches the takeoff config set in the MCDU.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. Press the T.O. CONFIG button — if no blue messages appear on ECAM, the aircraft is correctly configured for takeoff.
items.label: T.O. Config Test

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity flashes on the wingtips. Required when entering the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Bright forward lights for visibility below 10,000 ft and on the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Brighter setting than taxi for the takeoff roll.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Additional forward illumination for the takeoff roll.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Pedals.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Center Pedestal. Advance to about 25% first, then push to FLX/MCT detent (flex takeoff) or TOGA (full thrust). The FADEC sets the target N1.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Sidestick. Start rotation at VR — initially max 10 degrees pitch, then target about 15 degrees. The A380 is long, gentle rotation prevents a tail strike.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main Panel. Once the vertical speed is confirmed positive on the PFD.
items.label: Positive Climb

items.info: Center Pedestal. At FMA "LVR CLB" message, pull thrust levers back to the CLB detent.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Follow the green speed bugs on the PFD speed tape: at "F" select Flaps 1 (if Config 2 takeoff), at "S" select Flaps 0.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Main Panel. Confirm gear is up and locked — no amber on the gear indicator.
items.label: Landing Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. No longer needed once airborne and clean.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off in the air.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off in the air.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. If turned off for takeoff performance, restore now.
items.label: Packs

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify still in full TA/RA mode after takeoff.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off above 10,000 ft to save bulb life.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Usually off in smooth air above 10,000 ft.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Glareshield. Set standard pressure (1013 hPa / 29.92 inHg) at the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Cycle based on ride conditions and turbulence forecasts.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: ECAM. Verify cabin altitude is tracking correctly — the A380 pressurises to about 5,000 ft cabin altitude at FL430.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Center Pedestal. Rule of thumb: (cruise alt - target alt) / 1000 x 3 + 10 = minimum descent distance in NM. Also visible on the FMS F-PLN page as T/D.
items.label: Top Of Descent

items.info: Center Pedestal. Pull destination weather and runway info roughly 50 NM before top of descent.
items.label: Arrival ATIS

items.info: Center Pedestal. F-PLN page: select destination, pick RWY/APPR/STAR/TRANS. Insert the temporary flight plan. PERF APPR tab: enter wind, OAT, QNH, and minimums.
items.label: FMS Approach

items.info: Center Pedestal. BTV (Brake To Vacate) if desired, or a numeric setting. Match it to runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Center Pedestal. FMS NAV AID page — verify the ILS for the planned runway is tuned.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Glareshield. Set the altitude of the last waypoint before the runway. Do not push yet — that initiates the descent.
items.label: FCU Altitude

items.info: Overhead Panel. Consider turning seat belts back on if turbulence is expected during descent.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Glareshield. Push the altitude selector knob at top of descent. The aircraft starts a managed descent following the VNAV profile.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both signs on below 10,000 ft. Time for the cabin to prepare.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Back on passing 10,000 ft for traffic visibility.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Bright setting below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Additional illumination below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Glareshield. Displays the ILS localiser and glideslope scales on the PFD.
items.label: LS Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Set local pressure passing the transition level. The altimeter now reads height above sea level again.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Glareshield. Press APPR on the FCU. Arms LOC and G/S capture — verify blue armed modes on the FMA.
items.label: Approach Mode

items.info: Glareshield. Confirm localiser and glideslope diamonds are visible on the PFD.
items.label: LS Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Final check that autobrake is armed for landing.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Glareshield. Set the go-around altitude in the FCU so the aircraft levels off correctly if you push TOGA.
items.label: Missed Approach Alt

items.info: Center Pedestal. Select at green dot speed. First slat extension for deceleration.
items.label: Flaps 1

items.info: Center Pedestal. Select at "S" speed on the PFD tape.
items.label: Flaps 2

items.info: Main Panel. The A380 has 22 wheels across 5 gear assemblies. Confirm all green on the gear indicator.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Center Pedestal. Intermediate landing flap step.
items.label: Flaps 3

items.info: Center Pedestal. Final landing configuration. The A380X uses Config 4 — there is no FULL detent.
items.label: Flaps 4

items.info: Center Pedestal. Arms the spoilers to deploy automatically on touchdown.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Retard at 50 ft — pull thrust levers to idle. The aircraft callout "RETARD" is your cue.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Sidestick. At 40 ft slowly pitch to about 4-5 degrees nose up. The A380 sits low so the flare is gentle.
items.label: Flare

items.info: Center Pedestal. Full reverse on all four engines down to about 80 kts, then idle reverse only.
items.label: Reverse Thrust

items.info: Center Pedestal. At 40 kts bring thrust levers forward out of reverse to forward idle.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedals. Manual braking before the exit disengages autobrake and gives you direct control for the turnoff.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Back to AUTO once clear of the runway — they will stay off on the ground.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off once clear of the active runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Dim taxi setting for the taxi-in.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Keep on at night for taxiway visibility, off during day.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Bring the APU back online so it can take over electrics and bleed at the gate.
items.label: APU

items.info: Center Pedestal. Stow the speed brake lever.
items.label: Ground Spoilers

items.info: Center Pedestal. Clean up flaps so ground vehicles do not catch on them.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Center Pedestal. FMS SURV page — TCAS to standby on the ground.
items.label: TCAS

items.info: Glareshield. Clear the ILS display from the PFD.
items.label: LS Mode

items.info: Center Pedestal. Set once parked at the gate.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off at the gate.
items.label: Nose Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. No longer needed at the gate.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. APU takes over pneumatic supply before engines shut down.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Center Pedestal. Verify in NORM position.
items.label: ENG Mode Selector

items.info: Center Pedestal. All four switches OFF. Engines spool down over about a minute.
items.label: Engine Masters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Signs off — passengers can deplane.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off once engines have stopped spinning. Tells ground crew it is safe to approach.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. All fuel pumps off after engine shutdown.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Close the crew oxygen valve.
items.label: Oxygen Crew Supply

items.info: Overhead Panel. All three to OFF.
items.label: ADIRS

items.info: Overhead Panel. All remaining exterior lights off.
items.label: Exterior Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Off before APU shutdown.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shuts down the APU. External power takes over if connected.
items.label: APU Master

items.info: Overhead Panel. All four switches off. Aircraft fully de-powered.
items.label: Battery

description: King of the Air, the double-deck superjumbo is the largest passenger aircraft ever built.
